town.title: Town Council
town.difficulty: everyday to hard tasks on small accounts
town.planningMode: CLOOP town. Apply the main prompt; reread cloop/board.md after context loss. Route line first (DIRECT / FOCUSED / FULL). Counter the defaults: remove before adding, whole before detail, goal before measure. DEFINE: the council drafts the rubric (CORE / NON-CORE, one property per criterion, optional items to the backlog) and, for a new repo, spec and architecture in cloop/; run each criterion's literal wording against real cases; freeze. EXPLORE when the output shape is unclear: 3–5 parallel single-file one-shots, judged blind, winner by rule. CLIMB: CORE stage, then NON-CORE stage, each = one-shot → small loops → gate. One-shot: PREVENT step back, ONE self-contained file (Rosetta translation if the stack is unfamiliar), real run, check (good ≈80%, range 60–100%: integrate by refactor or translation against its outputs, delete the file; bad: re-DEFINE or EXPLORE, never small loops). Small loop: PREVENT (reproduce on BEST, route LOCAL / RELATIONAL with run boundary rows / UNSETTLED / UNDECIDABLE) → brief quoting the criterion → smallest coherent correction on BEST, regression test seen failing on BEST → judges review targeted + touched criteria on a frozen commit → CORRECT (small step back, one construction) or ACCEPT. Gates: core gate; release gate = full run + full suite once + full review; a reproduced violation blocks, no vote. Judges = reviewers (read-only, write nothing); duelers = loop-breakers (diagnose apart, cross-examine, each one bounded self-verified loop, you merge by rule, judges review). Outcomes: REGRESSION, PASS, ADVANCED, STALLED, BLOCKED. Triggers override allowances; ladder: repair differently → DUEL → EXPLORE → re-DEFINE. Never reinterpret the rubric, accept a proxy, weaken a test, skip judging, or count a rubric change as progress. Status line + two tables + Next after every check, loop and gate. Autonomous until a real blocker. Delete task files on PASS.
